findings.reason: closing §18 against its heading records a bound the plan does not contain, and the sections that would carry it are not filed or routed, so a coordinator reading §18 done will believe the pass is bounded when nothing in the plan bounds it.
findings.text: §18's heading promises "An obligations pass finishes well inside the snapshot window", but its deliverable is an investigation that "changes no product code" and only "proposes the repair as one or more sections of this plan", so the section declares a goal it does not itself reach or bound

findings.reason: a node following §6 literally measures its base and head arms over a tree that other sessions are changing, so the comparison §6 exists to make rests on a corpus the plan has already shown to be unstable.
findings.text: §6's deliverable runs the measurement "on the live reckon corpus", but §7 (done, line 143) records that a live corpus moves between runs and therefore runs its reads "against one frozen copy of the corpus, so that run-record churn cannot move the figures"; §6's own executed re-measurement used a pinned extraction at `5259135ac`, contradicting its own text
